summary: A solo-friendly ecosystem-building puzzle where players draft biome cards to grow forests on their own board, balancing tree height, sunlight, and adjacency so their canopy doesn't shade itself out. It plays as a quiet, contemplative optimization game rather than a confrontational one, with light indirect interaction over card availability.
praised: soothing, meditative theme executed well through art and components
clever light/shadow mechanic for tree growth adds real puzzle depth
works well solo and scales smoothly to more players
criticised: some find the scoring and bonus tracking fiddly
limited long-term replay variety once the systems are learned

interaction.kind: mostly parallel play with light drafting contention

scoring.why: points accrue from tree growth, biome completion, and end-game bonus cards, rewarding whoever built the most efficient ecosystem
